runs.text: Overall,two roundabouts were added, the bus stops along the Hospital Rd has replaced by a independent bus station,and the car park was separated for staff and public.
In 2007,Ring Road surrounded the whole city hospital and connected to Hospital Rd in the south.There were six bus stops along the Hospital Rd and both sides of Hospital Rd has three bus stops.
There was also a single car park at the east of Hospital Rd,and at the south side of the road lied a City Road from west to the east.
By 2010,the roundabouts had been added at both ends of Hospital Rd. The public car park was built near Ring Road.
